verdict.rationale: A built-in AI agent is a fair axis for a terminal emulator, since competing terminals such as Warp ship one, so this is "none" rather than "na". Nothing in the evidence pack describes a built-in AI agent, command planning, or an approval flow in Ghostty. The documented features cover rendering, themes, configuration, keybindings and AppleScript automation, and a runtime probe found no remote-control or IPC interface for external agents.
